faqs.q: Is there a limit on product options?
faqs.a: No. Add as many product options as each product needs.

faqs.q: What kinds of options can I add?
faqs.a: Choices such as dropdowns, swatches and text inputs, for simple or complex products.
Yes. Options can work together with your pricing rules.

faqs.q: Do options work with the design editor?
